purpose: Teach: みなす/逃れる/しようが/見なさ/傾き/負い/懲り/劣る

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは翔くんを未だ子供とみなす日もあるのよ
lines.en: Sho, sometimes your dad still sees you as a kid, you know.
lines.style: Warm, almost conspiratorial tone. Gentle but matter-of-fact — not coddling. Slight pause before the final phrase, giving weight to the observation without pressing it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんから逃れるなんて考えないよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I don't think I could ever run away from Dad.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Small voice but steady. No performance — just a fact he's stating simply. Almost thoughtful, like he's realizing it as he says it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、「しようがない」って思わずに乗り越えていきましょうね
lines.en: Sho, don't just accept things the way they are. Try to move past them.
lines.style: Gentle but with underlying firmness. Not a lecture — more like a quiet challenge from someone who believes he's capable of more. Warm encouragement underneath the directness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんに見なされてないって不安だよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, it worries me that Dad doesn't really see me.
lines.style: Vulnerable, hesitant opening. The worry underneath is real and quiet. His voice gets smaller on the second half — he's admitting something he maybe hasn't said aloud before.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが本棚の傾きを直して下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad said he'll fix that tilt in the bookshelf for us.
lines.style: Conversational shift — warmer, almost lighter. Not dismissing what he said before, but gently redirecting with a small gesture of his father's care. Noticing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんが家族の責任を負い続けてらっしゃると思う
lines.en: Mei-sis, I think Dad's been carrying the weight of the family this whole time.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost adult-sounding. Small voice but not uncertain — he's piecing something together. Quiet respect underneath the words.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達との喧嘩に懲りた様子の翔くんが可愛いわ
lines.en: Sho, it's kind of cute how you've learned your lesson from that fight with your friend.
lines.style: Affectionate, teasing-gentle. A small smile in the voice. She's noticing growth in him without making him self-conscious about it. Tender amusement.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに劣ると思わずに頑張るよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm going to try my best without thinking I'm worse than Dad.
lines.style: Resolved determination in a small voice. He's made a quiet commitment to himself. Not boasting — just steady. The closing line of someone finding his own footing.
